title: Pocket run annotator — Harrison Liu
content:
Purpose: lightning personal ledger for short runs — capture enough to triage regressions quickly and decide follow-ups. Not replacing formal sheets; this is messy, compact, single-file tracker for daily tinkering.

Column headers:
date, run_id, model, variant, quant, batch_size, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, success, notes, tags

Rows (most recent first):
2026-02-17, r-20260217-09, rw-13b-v2, cpu-fallback, int8, 1, 48, 220, 268, 123, 312, 0.044, Y, "prefix cache warmed; consistent | small hallucination in step 3" , smoke,cache
2026-02-16, r-20260216-34, rw-13b-v2, cuda-rtx6000, q4f16, 4, 32, 64, 96, 89, 210, 0.031, Y, "batching 4 => ~15% latency increase p95 but cost drop; try batch 2 next" , batching,perf
2026-02-15, r-20260215-02, vicuna-13b, cpu, fp16, 1, 120, 32, 152, 210, 540, 0.098, N, "OOM on sequence=1024 with kv-preserve on; fallback used rw-13b-v2; investigate memory baseline" , oom,investigate
2026-01-28, r-20260128-11, rw-70b, tpu-proto, q2, 1, 16, 8, 24, 410, 980, 0.45, Y, "high variance p95; noisy infra; check const-io spikes around 01:10 UTC" , infra,noise
2025-11-03, r-20251103-05, rw-7b, g4dn, q4f16, 8, 10, 40, 50, 34, 88, 0.012, Y, "cheap baseline for demo; tokens small; output quality OK" , demo,baseline

Quick observations:
- Int8 (q4f16) on RTX reduced cost ~30% vs fp16 with small p95 hit for batch >=4. Useful for background tasks.
- Prefix/KV cache saves ~25% p50 for multi-step prompts if warm. Keep short warmup for user flows.
- Memory OOM on vicuna-13b when kv-preserve + long seqs — probably model weight + kv working set mismatch on certain instance types.

Immediate todos / experiment ideas:
- [ ] Run batch sweep (1,2,4,8) on rw-13b q4f16 with identical prompts; capture p50/p95 and token cost. Goal: find knee where p95 rises sharply. (ticket: JIRA-INF-2103 linked)
- [ ] Reproduce OOM locally with sequence 1024 on vicuna-13b using small repro script — attach logs.
- [ ] Add a quick flag to runtime that dumps peak GPU memory with kv-preserve enabled for debug. (PR stubbed: github #874)

Notes-to-self / shorthand:
- "success" = produced valid completion w/o truncation; if fallback used mark N and call out fallback.
- cost_per_1k_usd computed from internal rate card (approx): GPU-minutes * rate / tokens * 1000 — rough.
- When adding rows: keep run_id as r-YYYYMMDD-XX, include variant to see fallback vs native.

Unresolved questions:
- Why did rw-70b show p95 spikes only on 2026-01-28 window? Compare infra logs + tracing: trace ids in CONSOLE.
- Is the vicuna OOM reproducible on g5a vs g4dn? Schedule quick compare once repro script ready.

End-of-file quick summary (1-liner):
Pocket ledger for day-to-day micro-runs: capture model/variant/quant/batch, p50/p95, token counts, cost estimate, and one-line notes so I can sync with Leah/Ravi before we escalate to SRE or file a formal bug.

References / recent links:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/874
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2103
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/KV+cache+experiments

End.
